name: Simple Recent Posts Widget
author: Anshul Gangrade

sections.description:
Simple Recent Posts Widget is an easy-to-use plugin for displaying your recent posts in a beautiful List or Grid layout. Use the [simple_recent_posts] shortcode to place it anywhere, or drag and drop it visually using your favorite page builders like Elementor, Gutenberg, or WPBakery!

New in Version 3.0

  • Shortcode Support: Place [simple_recent_posts] anywhere in your content.
  • Page Builder Integrations: Native blocks and widgets for Elementor, Gutenberg, and WPBakery.
  • Grid Layouts: Choose between traditional List layout or a responsive Grid.
  • Excerpts & Read More: Show a snippet of content and a “Read More” button.
  • Exclude Current Post: Smart option to hide the current post from the recent posts list so users don’t see duplicate content.
  • PHP 8 Compatibility: Fully modernized codebase.

Standard Features

  • Control number of posts displayed
  • Control number of posts to skip (offset)
  • Optionally display post thumbnails & date
  • Choose post type to display

Donate Me

sections.installation:
1. Upload the simple-recent-posts-widget folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to Appearance > Widgets
  4. Select “Simple Recent Posts” on sidebar.
